--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Padics.PadicNumbers
instance complete : CauSeq.IsComplete ℚ_[p] norm where
  isComplete f := by
    have cau_seq_norm_e : IsCauSeq padicNormE f := fun ε hε => by
      have h := isCauSeq f ε (mod_cast hε)
      dsimp [norm] at h
      exact mod_cast h
    -- Porting note: Padic.complete' works with `f i - q`, but the goal needs `q - f i`,
    -- using `rewrite [padicNormE.map_sub]` causes time out, so a separate lemma is created
    cases' Padic.complete'' ⟨f, cau_seq_norm_e⟩ with q hq
    exists q
    intro ε hε
    cases' exists_rat_btwn hε with ε' hε'
    norm_cast at hε'
    cases' hq ε' hε'.1 with N hN
    exists N
    intro i hi
    have h := hN i hi
    change norm (f i - q) < ε
    refine lt_trans ?_ hε'.2
    dsimp [norm]
    exact mod_cast h

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem ω_pow_eq_one (p' : ℕ) (h : lucasLehmerResidue (p' + 2) = 0) :
    (ω : X (q (p' + 2))) ^ 2 ^ (p' + 2) = 1 :=
  calc
    (ω : X (q (p' + 2))) ^ 2 ^ (p' + 2) = (ω ^ 2 ^ (p' + 1)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_succ]
    _ = (-1) ^ 2 := by rw [ω_pow_eq_neg_one p' h]
    _ = 1 := by simp

        cast_pow, cast_ofNat] at h
    apply Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_nonneg_of_lt _ _ h <;> clear h
    · exact sMod_nonneg _ (by positivity) _
    · exact sMod_lt _ (by positivity) _
  · intro h
    rw [h]

  rw [sModNatTR, helper, sModNat_aux_eq]

/-- The **Sprague-Grundy theorem** states that every impartial game is equivalent to a game of nim,

theorem equiv_nim_grundyValue (G : PGame.{u}) [G.Impartial] :
    G ≈ nim (toOrdinal (grundyValue G)) := by
  rw [Impartial.equiv_iff_add_equiv_zero, ← Impartial.forall_leftMoves_fuzzy_iff_equiv_zero]
  intro x
  apply leftMoves_add_cases x <;>
  intro i
  · rw [add_moveLeft_inl,
      ← fuzzy_congr_left (add_congr_left (Equiv.symm (equiv_nim_grundyValue _))),
      nim_add_fuzzy_zero_iff]
    exact grundyValue_ne_moveLeft i
  · rw [add_moveLeft_inr, ← Impartial.exists_left_move_equiv_iff_fuzzy_zero]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_grundyValue_moveLeft_of_lt <| toLeftMovesNim_symm_lt i
    use toLeftMovesAdd (Sum.inl j)
    rw [add_moveLeft_inl, moveLeft_nim]
    exact Equiv.trans (add_congr_left (equiv_nim_grundyValue _)) (hj ▸ Impartial.add_self _)
termination_by G

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sMod_nonneg (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ sMod p i := by
  cases i <;> dsimp [sMod]
  · exact sup_eq_right.mp rfl
  · apply Int.emod_nonneg
    exact mersenne_int_ne_zero p hp

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sZMod_eq_s (p' : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : sZMod (p' + 2) i = (s i : ZMod (2 ^ (p' + 2) - 1)) := by
  induction' i with i ih
  · dsimp [s, sZMod]
    norm_num
  · push_cast [s, sZMod, ih]; rfl
-- These next two don't make good `norm_cast` lemmas.

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Nimber.Basic
/-- `Ordinal.induction` but for `Nimber`. -/
theorem induction {p : Nimber → Prop} : ∀ (i) (_ : ∀ j, (∀ k, k < j → p k) → p j), p i :=
  Ordinal.induction

theorem isNat_not_lucasLehmerTest : {p np : ℕ} →
    IsNat p np → ¬ LucasLehmerTest np → ¬ LucasLehmerTest p
  | _, _, ⟨rfl⟩, h => h

--src: Mathlib.Data.Part
theorem mod_mem_mod [Mod α] (a b : Part α) (ma mb : α) (ha : ma ∈ a) (hb : mb ∈ b) :
    ma % mb ∈ a % b := by simp [mod_def]; aesop

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Ordinal.Arithmetic
theorem mod_lt (a) {b : Ordinal} (h : b ≠ 0) : a % b < b :=
  (add_lt_add_iff_left (b * (a / b))).1 <| by rw [div_add_mod]; exact lt_mul_div_add a h

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Nimber.Field
instance : IsCancelMulZero Nimber where
  mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero ha h := by
    rw [← add_eq_zero, ← Nimber.mul_add, mul_eq_zero] at h
    exact add_eq_zero.1 (h.resolve_left ha)
  mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero ha h := by
    rw [← add_eq_zero, ← Nimber.add_mul, mul_eq_zero] at h
    exact add_eq_zero.1 (h.resolve_right ha)

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.FermatPsp
/-- Infinite set variant of `Nat.exists_infinite_pseudoprimes`
-/
theorem infinite_setOf_pseudoprimes {b : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ b) :
    Set.Infinite { n : ℕ | FermatPsp n b } :=
  Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite.mp (frequently_atTop_fermatPsp h)

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem residue_eq_zero_iff_sMod_eq_zero (p : ℕ) (w : 1 < p) :
    lucasLehmerResidue p = 0 ↔ sMod p (p - 2) = 0 := by
  dsimp [lucasLehmerResidue]
  rw [sZMod_eq_sMod p]
  constructor
  · -- We want to use that fact that `0 ≤ s_mod p (p-2) < 2^p - 1`
    -- and `lucas_lehmer_residue p = 0 → 2^p - 1 ∣ s_mod p (p-2)`.
    intro h
    simp? [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h says
      simp only [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd, ofNat_pos, pow_pos, cast_pred,
        cast_pow, cast_ofNat] at h
    apply Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_nonneg_of_lt _ _ h <;> clear h
    · exact sMod_nonneg _ (by positivity) _
    · exact sMod_lt _ (by positivity) _
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    simp

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.FermatPsp
theorem frequently_atTop_fermatPsp {b : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ b) : ∃ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, FermatPsp n b := by
  -- Based on the proof of `Nat.frequently_atTop_modEq_one`
  refine Filter.frequently_atTop.2 fun n => ?_
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_infinite_pseudoprimes h n
  exact ⟨p, hp.2, hp.1⟩

  rw [sZMod_eq_sMod p]

    apply Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_nonneg_of_lt _ _ h <;> clear h
    · exact sMod_nonneg _ (by positivity) _
